name: crm
description: Follow-target service: screenshot ingest, VLM extraction, per-personality dedupe ledger, metered handout

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix server exec -- vitest run --project unit

comments.why-no-workspaces: server/ and web/ keep their own node_modules on purpose. npm workspaces would hoist them to the root, and Prisma resolves its generated client and native query engine relative to the package that owns the schema -- hoisting has broken that in the past. These scripts only forward to the two packages, so nothing about their installs changes.
comments.order: npm run setup, then start Postgres, then npm run migrate, then npm run api and npm run web in two shells.
